mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls above 150k signals stronger labor demand, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where the trigger fires (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the Housing Starts Index below 1.2 million signals weakening residential demand, which reduces construction-related earnings and drags on S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where the trigger fires (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in the Industrial Production Index below 1% signals slowing manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where the trigger fires (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where the trigger fires (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures below $330 billion signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate sales and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where the trigger fires (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4% signals labor market overheating, which increases wage pressure and prompts restrictive monetary policy, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where the trigger fires (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in GDP (billions chained 2017 dollars) below 1% signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where the trigger fires (t-test p > 0.05).
